description:
ESC benchmark diagnostic dataset
	


	
		
		Dataset Summary
	

As a part of ESC benchmark, we provide a small, 8h diagnostic dataset of in-domain validation data with newly annotated transcriptions. The audio data is sampled from each of the ESC validation sets, giving a range of different domains and speaking styles. The transcriptions are annotated according to a consistent style guide with two formats: normalised and un-normalised. reputation: Provided as an in-domain diagnostic split for the ESC benchmark; valued by speech researchers for consistent, re-annotated validation data but modest in overall community adoption.
